description: Crypto token launch sky (token astrology chart, data only): the planets' signs, degrees, retrogrades and aspects at a token's launch moment (block time of its deployment or mint), plus the exact UTC dates ahead when planets return to or aspect those positions (key astronomical dates, unix timestamps for backtests) and a shareable SVG card. E.g. {launch_datetime: '2018-08-03T19:28:24Z', token: {symbol: 'USDC'}, from: '2026-11-01'}. Give a token's launch moment (the block time of its contract deployment or mint, UTC, to the second) and get the geocentric sky at that instant: each planet's sign, degree, longitude and retrograde flag, the major aspects between them, element and modality balance (no houses: a token has no place). Then the key dates: the exact UTC minute, over up to 366 days from 'from', at which each transiting planet returns to its launch position or aspects a launch position, each with a unix timestamp and a stable key, in rows ready for pandas. result.card.svg is a server-rendered 1200x675 card (wheel, positions, next key dates) ready to post. Key astronomical dates, data only — never a signal or forecast. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.25 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/finance/token-chart (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.

days.description: How many days of key dates from 'from'.

from.description: First UTC date of the key dates, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today (UTC); pass it for a reproducible call. Example: '2026-11-01'.

launch_datetime.description: The token's launch moment in UTC: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, to the second ('2018-08-03T19:28:24Z'), or unix seconds (an on-chain block time). Use the block time of the contract deployment or of the mint, from an explorer.

limit.description: Maximum key dates returned (counts.key_dates gives the total).

orbs.description: Orb overrides in degrees per aspect, e.g. {'conjunction': 6}.

token.description: Optional label drawn on the card and echoed in the result. On-chain resolution of the launch time is not available yet: give launch_datetime.

address.description: Contract or mint address (shown on the card).

name.description: Name shown on the card, e.g. 'USD Coin'.

symbol.description: Ticker shown on the card, e.g. 'USDC'.

transit_bodies.description: Transiting bodies timed against the launch positions (default all nine).

name: token_chart

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

aspects.description: Major aspects between the launch planets: bodies, aspect, angle, orb, state and a readable label.

card.description: The shareable card: format image/svg+xml, width, height and the SVG text.

counts.description: Number of key dates found and returned, and of launch aspects.

key_dates.description: Exact UTC dates ahead: date_utc, unix timestamp, transit body, aspect, launch point, kind (return or aspect), retrograde flag, label and a stable key.

planets.description: The launch sky by body: name, glyph, sign, degree, minute, 'deg' text, position, longitude, speed, retrograde flag, element, modality.

returns.description: The first return of each transiting body to its own launch position in the window.

settings.description: Settings applied: zodiac, frame, no houses, aspects and orbs, and the key-date window (from, to, transit bodies, launch points, limit, precision).

subject.description: The launch moment (launch_utc) and the token label you gave (chain, address, symbol, name).

summary.description: Sun and Moon signs, retrograde bodies, element and modality balance, aspect count.

title: Token launch sky (crypto token chart)
